name: ugchooks
description: MCP connector for UGCHooks: create TikTok and Reels post batches from product links and read hooks, captions and hashtags.
long_description: Paste a product link, get 100 TikToks and Reels: slideshows, reaction hook videos and GIF memes with captions. get_profile reads your email and credits. list_batches and get_batch read your post batches with hooks, slide text, captions, hashtags and saved render links. create_batch turns a product link into a brief and the first 10 posts; write_part writes parts of batches you unlocked. No credit spending, unlocking or posting.
